critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In FloatingContactWidget.jsx panel is always in the DOM with pointer-events toggled; that is fine but a screen reader might announce hidden options. Consider aria-hidden={!open}.
Minor: Footer newsletter dead-code toast.error branch (carried over from iteration_2) remains — with noValidate now on the form the branch is reachable, so this is resolved.

Minor: /api/clinic-info returns whatsapp as '+919417258159' (with leading '+') but frontend uses '919417258159' constant. Both work with wa.me but the API string with '+' will not build a working https://wa.me/+91… link if consumed directly by any future client — consider standardising (drop '+' in API values, keep '+' for tel: fields only).

Sticky mobile CTA + floating-contact-toggle are both bottom-fixed on mobile; verify vertical spacing (floating widget sits at bottom-24, sticky CTA at bottom-3 — currently OK but any bottom-safe-area change could cause overlap).
